in_hebrew.name: Jemimah
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Dove, Beautiful, Grace
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Jemimah הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Jemimah means ‘graceful little dove’ in Hebrew. In the Bible, Jemimah was a beautiful virgin from Jerusalem, who was one of King Solomon’s 700 wives. Her name is mentioned in 1 Kings 11:2, as one of Solomon’s wives who turned his heart away from the LORD. Her beauty and grace represented the divine presence and God’s favor.

in_latin.name: Jemimah
in_latin.meaning: nomen feminitatis de origine Hebraica, quod significat 'dormio, requiescam'
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Jemimah est origine Hebraica et significat 'dormio, requiescam'. In lingua Hebraica, radix 'yamim' est verbum 'dormio' vel 'requiescam.' Nomen Jemimah est etymologicus equivalent Latinus 'somnium.' In traditione Christiana, nomen Jemimah videtur non esse nomen biblicum, sed potest esse nomen inspiratum a scriptura Hebraica, quae loquitur de somnium et requies. In lingua Latina, nomen Jemimah videtur esse nomen femininum, quod significat 'dormio, requiescam.'
